description: A design-review screenshot proves 'the FE serving :PORT looked like this THEN', never 'this is how it is NOW'. A stale FE (behind main) makes an already-fixed bug look live — this bit us live: a /v2 fortune-card capture at FE d58a6b8 showed an empty/stuck card that #110 had already fixed; the reporter (me) called it a live finding without checking the FE build (บอง + goo caught it). Fix: harness/capture-route.ts auto-records the FE build every run — detectFeBuild() = lsof :port -> serving worktree cwd -> git HEAD + commits-BEHIND origin/main, printed as '🏷️ FE build @capture: <hash> ... BEHIND origin/main' and required in evidence; CAPTURE.md adds the 'images expire — confirm FE current before trusting a capture' rule. Verify-the-instrument (neg-control): the SAME tool renders empty fortune at d58a6b8 (pre-fix) vs 'B+ 70%' at 20d3d05 (post-fix) — it reflects the FE's REAL state, does not fabricate; the recorded hash makes which-state unambiguous. Same shape as absence-vs-unchanged: a point-in-time image is not the present. gate_layer=process/evidence-integrity.
